description: Returns daily bars (date, open, high, low, close, volume) for up to five years (about 1,260 sessions), adjusted for share splits only: the prices that traded, in today's shares, with dividends and spin-offs not subtracted. Compact: `fields` names the columns once and each bar is one row in that order, oldest first. Use it when the user needs price data for a chart or a calculation.

sessions.description: Most recent sessions to return (default 120, max 1300).

symbol.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, AMD, ASML, 'nvidia', 'taiwan semiconductor'. Case-insensitive.

name: get_price_history
title: Daily price history
